name: MAHSR BKC - Thane (existing design, from public sources)
source: Line: OpenStreetMap ways 916108435 + 1125530002 (ODbL), anchored at the portal CH 21.150. Levels: published depths and one JICA rail level - see profile.pins.

pins.name: BKC station (rail)
pins.source: https://openjicareport.jica.go.jp/pdf/12302873_02.pdf (FAD 2018: ~26 m ground to rail); platform ~24 m, base slab ~32 m (press)

pins.name: Vikhroli shaft
pins.source: https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/india/ahmedabad-mumbai-bullet-train-project-indias-largest-tunnel-boring-machine-begins-excavation/ — shaft ~56 m deep; rail taken ~3 m above the shaft base (assumption)

pins.name: Sawli shaft (Ghansoli)
pins.source: https://metrorailnews.in/mumbai-ahmedabad-bullet-train-second-tbm-begins-work-on-indias-first-undersea-rail-tunnel-beneath-thane-creek/ — shaft ~39 m deep; rail taken ~3 m above the shaft base (assumption)

pins.name: near Shilphata portal
pins.source: https://openjicareport.jica.go.jp/pdf/12302873_02.pdf (FAD 2018, pre-detailed design: RL 30.146 m at Km 21/112)

structures: C-2: TBM to Sawli, NATM Sawli - Shilphata
notes: Plan from OpenStreetMap: the creek crossing is mapped as one straight 9.3 km chord between the reported Vikhroli and Sawli shaft positions - accurate to a few hundred metres at best.
Levels are pinned at four published points (BKC box, two shafts, one JICA 2018 rail level near the portal); everything between them is the designer's tunnel policy - an estimate.
Shaft depth is not rail level: the rail is assumed ~3 m above the shaft base (low confidence).

Thane Creek bed depth is not in any DEM (water is flat in Copernicus); the tunnel policy's 'creek bed below water' parameter is an assumption to vary (published: 2-6 m below chart datum in the middle/upper creek; tunnel 20-25 m below the bed).
The detailed-design L-section is not public; the user's own NHSRCL data supersedes all of this.
